desc: 锥形纤维刷头逐根捕捉睫毛，刷出假睫毛般浓密纤长妆效，不结块不苍蝇腿
name: 假睫毛级浓密纤长睫毛膏款

shots.intent: 点击页第一眼：管身外观与刷头一次看清，建立假睫毛级效果的品质预期
三秒读懂三大卖点：不结块、逐根捕捉、深黑浓妆
直击素睫稀短痛点，同机位上下对比证明假睫毛级妆效
展示正确涂刷角度与服帖妆效，建立可复制的使用想象
情感升温：笑容、妆效与产品同框传达自信结果
放大纤维刷毛与锥形轮廓，支撑不结块与逐根捕捉的可信度
用五项免除图标打清成分顾虑，强化温和安心
社交证明背书加速犹豫期决策，数据只引用可验证事实
为多色号扩展预留统一版式：换底色即换变体，主图色保持一致
漏斗收口：产品+核心承诺+行动引导一屏闭环

style.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshots; magenta-to-mint gradient #C2449A to #D9EFD9 for benefit cards; purple #9B59C7 and periwinkle #A9BEEC reserved for portrait and social-proof cards
style.direction: high-saturation youthful masstige eye-makeup commerce: clean white studio packshots anchored by magenta-to-mint gradient scene cards
style.iconSystem: thin-line white minimal icons on rounded badges; red-ring dot markers for claims
style.lightingSystem: even shadowless studio light on white shots, soft top-right key with soft lower-left shadow on gradient cards, macro top light plus side fill for brush details
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: high-saturation youthful masstige eye-makeup commerce across the whole set. Clean white studio packshots #FFFFFF with even shadowless light; benefit cards on magenta-to-mint gradients #C2449A to #D9EFD9; portrait and social-proof cards on purple #9B59C7 or periwinkle #A9BEEC. The glossy black tube #0B0B0D with mint accent #8CE6BC always faces the camera fully legible. Bold rounded sans-serif headlines in white or near-black #1A1A1A with short handwritten-script accents and highlight marks; thin-line white icons for claims and thin black leader lines for callouts. Soft diffused key light with subtle soft shadows on cards, macro top light plus side fill for brush details. Never shift the mint hue, never add props to white shots, never use serif fonts, brand logos, identifiable model faces, or unverified certification and sales numbers.
noDrift: no brand logos or source copy
no fabricated certifications or sales numbers
no new primary colors on gradient cards
style.presentationRules: tube and wand always vertical or horizontal centered with labels fully facing camera; the wand must appear alone at least once; eye close-ups must use matched framing before/after
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless backdrop paper and matte tabletop; skin is the surface for eye close-ups; a bold black mascara smear stroke is the only coarse texture motif
style.typography: bold rounded sans-serif headlines in white or near-black, short handwritten-script accent words only, thin black leader lines for callouts
